Reviewing `fix-session-token-total-2368` vs `origin/main`: 1 commit, 2 files changed  
Intent context: 1 checkpoint plus [issue #2368](https://github.com/entireio/cli/issues/2368) and [PR #2383](https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/2383).

Trail [#5](https://entire.io/gh/MuskanPaliwal/cli/trails/5) was identified, but direct fetching failed because both saved Entire contexts are logged out. I could not deduplicate against existing trail findings.

## cmd/entire/cli/strategy/subagent_tokens_test.go

Medium: Non-Copilot subagent tests no longer exercise the backfill they claim to guard.

  Intent: Only Copilot should perform session-token backfilling after this change.
  
  Actual: [The test at line 521](/Users/muskanpaliwal/Work/open-source/entire/cli/fix-session-token-total-2368/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/subagent_tokens_test.go:521) invokes the helper with Claude Code. It now returns immediately, making the following assertion pass through a no-op. [The later comment](/Users/muskanpaliwal/Work/open-source/entire/cli/fix-session-token-total-2368/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/subagent_tokens_test.go:628) also incorrectly says Claude’s input tokens trigger the backfill.
  
  Fix: Remove the obsolete no-op assertion and update the stale comment. Add a Copilot-path test where existing cumulative `SubagentTokens` survive either its full-session recomputation or checkpoint fallback.

## cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_condensation_test.go

Low: The deliberate “missing total stays missing” behavior is not pinned.

  Intent: A non-Copilot session without cumulative hook data should expose no session-wide total instead of promoting one checkpoint’s delta.
  
  Actual: [Both new non-Copilot tests](/Users/muskanpaliwal/Work/open-source/entire/cli/fix-session-token-total-2368/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_condensation_test.go:261) begin with an existing session total. A future conditional fallback for an empty total could therefore violate the PR’s stated contract while these tests still pass.
  
  Fix: Add a case with `state.TokenUsage == nil` and non-empty checkpoint usage, then assert that `state.TokenUsage` remains nil.

The production change itself matches the reported bug and I found no production correctness defect.

- Focused regression, Copilot fallback, and subagent tests
- Full `go test ./cmd/entire/cli/strategy -count=1`
- `git diff --check`

I’m also applying the `verify-fix` workflow because these changes are specifically meant to close review findings.

The fix will make the tests follow the new ownership boundary explicitly: non-Copilot checkpoint usage must never become a session total, while the remaining Copilot backfill must still preserve cumulative subagent accounting without mutating checkpoint metadata.
